Your wand's spells sit round a circle in the middle of the screen, each with its icon, name,

and, while recharging, the time left. The one under the mouse lights up in its element's colour and the middle says what it does. It pops open and shrinks away with a chime. A spell you cannot afford shows its cost in red.
While you hold a wand, a box on the HUD (bottom right; move it in the HUD editor) shows the selected spell: the icon, with the

down over it, its name, its mana cost, a charge bar for chargeable spells and a pip for each slot. Without enough mana the cost flashes red and says so; casting a recharging spell tells you how long is left.
Sneak and right click with the wand open its slots: a row where the wand's slots sit in the middle and the rest are locked. Drop a
into a slot to install it (each spell only once per wand), shift-click to move it in, and take it out again to get the scroll back. The wand cannot be moved while its slots are open.
